description.zh-CN: Codex 是 OpenAI 开源的编码智能体（Apache-2.0）。自包含单文件，下载即用：在终端里交给它任务，它会自己改代码、执行命令并汇报。需 ChatGPT 账号或 OpenAI API key。
description.en: Codex is OpenAI’s open-source coding agent (Apache-2.0). One self-contained executable — download and run: hand it a task and it edits code, executes commands and reports back. Needs a ChatGPT account or OpenAI API key.

runtime.note: Rust static CLI. Terminal-first: launch from PowerShell / Windows Terminal. Upstream macOS builds exist but are not shipped here until their dmg layout is verified.

packages.name: Codex CLI (self-contained, win32-x64)
packages.hashSource: GitHub release asset digest (2026-11-18, upstream published sha256)

install.notes: Copies the hash-verified binary into the user directory (same pattern as llamafile). No admin, no PATH mutation; launch from any terminal at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Codex\codex.exe.

packages.name: Codex CLI (dmg, arm64)
packages.hashSource: GitHub release asset digest (2026-11-18, upstream published sha256)

channels.note: Official dmg (flattened bin/codex + symlink, verified in upstream CI)

args: set -e; M=$(mktemp -d); hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly -mountpoint "$M" "$HOME/.aibox/cache/downloads/039f43abc0c6ea65d0ec52514cb86a052b546e02ea71374c700f8af17a0d96bc.dmg"; D="/Applications/Codex"; mkdir -p "$D"; ditto "$M" "$D"; hdiutil detach "$M"; rmdir "$M"
install.notes: Mount dmg and ditto its contents into /Applications/Codex (upstream layout: bin/codex + relative codex symlink + codex-resources). Run as /Applications/Codex/codex.

openai.label: OpenAI (ChatGPT account or API key)
openai.note: Codex signs in with a ChatGPT account (Plus/Pro/Team) or an OpenAI API key — run `codex login` after install.
openai.keyFormat: sk-... (API key) or ChatGPT OAuth login

recommendedModels.name: GPT-5.1 Codex
recommendedModels.note: Codex 专属优化模型，日常首选

upgrade.notes: Re-copy the new release binary over %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Codex\codex.exe; ~/.codex config survives.

uninstall.notes: ~/.codex holds your login token — delete it if you want credentials gone.

risk.onUninstall: 登录凭据与历史在 ~/.codex，删除即丢失（也应删除：含 token）

tagline.zh-CN: OpenAI 的编程智能体 CLI：在终端里替你写代码、跑命令、改仓库
tagline.en: OpenAI’s coding agent CLI — writes code, runs commands and edits repos from your terminal
